faq.question: How do I choose finishes?
faq.answer: Select the cabinet finish, countertop and handles applicable to the selected model and confirm the codes with your order.

faq.question: How is the cabinet packed?
faq.answer: Cabinets are preassembled at the factory. Components may be combined in crates according to the order dimensions and quantities.

faq.question: How do I identify the delivered components?
faq.answer: Match the cabinet identification labels inside the doors to the order drawings.

faq.question: What should I include in an inquiry?
faq.answer: Provide the model, quantity, room dimensions, preferred finishes, required accessories, electrical outlet standard and destination.

faq.question: How are installation details confirmed?
faq.answer: Confirm positioning, wall fixing, water, drainage and electrical connections against the approved project drawings.

faq.question: Is a screen or computer included?
faq.answer: Confirm the supplied equipment list. A holder or CPU storage compartment does not establish that a screen or computer is included.
